summary: Backend-only test of the Apple App Store screenshot ZIP endpoints fix (v114). All 4 endpoints return HTTP 200, Content-Type=application/zip, contain exactly 5 PNGs with the expected filenames and the EXACT dimensions required by Apple. Fix confirmed working via public EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL.
critical_code_review_comments: Endpoints (server.py L596-623) are properly implemented: use FileResponse with media_type='application/zip', return 404 if file missing. Clean and DRY.
Legacy endpoint /api/_downloads/appstore-screenshots-v114 (L583-593) correctly serves the 6.9" ZIP for backward compatibility.

Note: legacy endpoint currently reads a different file (appstore_screenshots_v114.zip) than the 6.9 endpoint (appstore_screenshots_6_9_v114.zip). Both happen to contain identical 1320x2868 content today. Consider consolidating to a single source file to avoid drift, but not blocking.
context_for_next_testing_agent:
Endpoint check details (measured over public URL):
- /api/_downloads/appstore-screenshots-v114     -> 200, application/zip, 1565 Ko, 5 PNGs @ 1320x2868 OK
- /api/_downloads/appstore-screenshots-6_9-v114 -> 200, application/zip, 1565 Ko, 5 PNGs @ 1320x2868 OK
- /api/_downloads/appstore-screenshots-6_7-v114 -> 200, application/zip, 1960 Ko, 5 PNGs @ 1290x2796 OK
- /api/_downloads/appstore-screenshots-6_5-v114 -> 200, application/zip, 1866 Ko, 5 PNGs @ 1242x2688 OK
All ZIPs contain the 5 expected filenames: 01_login.png, 02_dashboard.png, 03_modal_new_chantier.png, 04_fiche_chantier_wall_opt.png, 05_wizard_passer.png. Dimensions verified with PIL.Image.open(...).size. Pytest: 4 passed in 3.25s. (Global coverage gate failed at 19% but that is a pre-existing repo config, not a functional failure of these tests.)
rca_of_issue: N/A — the fix (3 size-specific endpoints + legacy alias) is confirmed working. Apple's 6.5" tab requires 1242x2688; the new /appstore-screenshots-6_5-v114 endpoint serves exactly that. Same for 6.7" (1290x2796) and 6.9" (1320x2868).
